namespace ProofScopeCert.CJ_y01_unrelated_both_true

theorem link_R : (2 + 2 = 4) ↔ ((2 : Nat) + (2 : Nat) = (4 : Nat)) := by
  first
    | ((constructor <;> intro h <;> intros <;> (first | (apply h <;> assumption) | (apply h <;> first | assumption | exact ⟨‹_›⟩) | (rename_i hn; obtain ⟨_⟩ := hn; apply h <;> assumption) | (simp_all))); done)

theorem link_L : (∀ (n : Nat), n + 0 = n) ↔ (∀ (n : Nat), n + (0 : Nat) = n) := by
  first
    | ((constructor <;> intro h <;> intros <;> (first | (apply h <;> assumption) | (apply h <;> first | assumption | exact ⟨‹_›⟩) | (rename_i hn; obtain ⟨_⟩ := hn; apply h <;> assumption) | (simp_all))); done)

theorem true_R : 2 + 2 = 4 := by
  first
    | ((decide); done)

theorem true_L : ∀ (n : Nat), n + 0 = n := by
  first
    | (((intros; omega)); done)

theorem equiv_both_true : (2 + 2 = 4) ↔ (∀ (n : Nat), n + 0 = n) := by
  first
    | ((exact ⟨fun _ => true_L, fun _ => true_R⟩); done)

end ProofScopeCert.CJ_y01_unrelated_both_true
